author: dreambig5
body:
Hey friend, I'm not sure what it is you're actually after. T10 Gear with most adorn slots? You have to consider which class you're using as well so I've added the various guides below (got it from this post: [https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1rnnzqv/comment/o989aot/?context=3](https://www.reddit.com/r/OrnaRPG/comments/1rnnzqv/comment/o989aot/?context=3) )

Also, I wanted to clarify the quality isn't exactly what affects adornment slots, but the higher the level that the gear is upgraded to, the more adorn slots become available (unless if it is anguished gear, in which case you get access to all adorn slots and it costs less materials to upgrade/masterforge/demonforge them). 

As far as gear, you can use this codex to look up items & evaluate its quality: [https://codex.fqegg.top/#/](https://codex.fqegg.top/#/)

As far as the various guides for different classes:
